items.html:
Generated upstream-only WASM fixtures and reproducible generator:

  • crates/treams-wasm/tests/reference.json: 209 KB, three cases with 30/60/48 modes.
  • scripts/generate_wasm_reference.py: pinned treams 0.4.5, NumPy 2.5.3, SciPy 1.16.3.

Includes multilayer chiral sphere, two-sphere cluster, lossless sphere; full column-major T matrices, incident/scattered coefficients, scattered Cartesian fields, and cross sections. Physical checks and Ruff passed.
